{{Top|leg}}
The '''Merr-Sonn Bellower''' was a powerful [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]] weapon used in the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] was capable of destroying [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. During the [[Battle of Ord Radama]], [[Darth Malgus]] noted that his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was unable to deflect blasts fired from the cannon.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
